name: v2.5.25
body:
## What's new in v2.5.25

- website: the APK button points at companion 1.0.13
- companion: 1.0.13
- companion: the new mark in the status bar and on the Play listing
- boot: no text between the splash and the interface
- image hooks: the Qt interface is what they finalise, not the Electron app
- kiosk: no start clip, the screen opens on the interface
- security: the paths, the error bodies and the blur index that CodeQL flagged
- flasher: dependencies past the advisories
- the Electron kiosk goes: nothing builds it, ships it or lists it any more
- library editor: a streamed track says it comes from a streaming service
- library editor: tags are written into every common format, WMA included
- companion: the new Osmium Sound icon
- library editor: the save bar follows the files, and each read-only file says why
- brand: the new Osmium Sound mark everywhere the appliance shows itself
- remote: the spotlight lands where each screen says, not nearest to where it was
- file manager: what it makes belongs to the share user, not root
- cd ripping: what a rip writes belongs to the share user, not root
- settings: the CD ripping hint no longer names where its layout comes from
- website: the Android app is on Google Play, badge and QR up front
- cd ripping: the bar moves inside a track; licenses: a wide card, licenses wrap
- folders are picked in one navigator, the File page's, on screen and in the web admin
- cd ripping: Daphile's settings page, a ripping log, cancel and eject at hand
- settings: a Licenses & credits page, with every package of the image
- squeezelite: one model owns the command line, Settings → Audio edits every option
- kiosk: the Artists view keeps to artists
- library: the artist list keeps to artists, composers stay on the tracks
- tidal connect: dropped everywhere
- lyrion setup: the playlist folder no longer undoes the skin the wizard just set
- remotes: the power key opens the restart / shut down menu
- remotes: a sound card's playback keys are not a remote
- touchscreen: its keyboard node is not a remote, a watcher for the freezes, and a restart in software
- remotes: drawn key maps shown whole, a key for the favourites, the practice run only after setup
- kiosk: trying the keys works with the remote alone, and actions keep the key map's names
- image: ship systemd-timesyncd, the clock no longer comes from the RTC alone
- installer: legacy BIOS PCs install the A/B layout too
- remotes: the wizard finds the Fire TV even when the background round pairs it first
- kiosk: a short remote page, and adding a remote is a step-by-step popup
- remotes: certified models pair by themselves, and the wizard says how
- webui: a known remote's key map after pairing; a remote's power key no longer switches the box off
- kiosk: known remotes work out of the box, with their key map and a practice run
- website: supporters show up as cards with what they wrote
- website: thank Ko-fi supporters by name under the Ko-fi button
- image: Broadcom BCM4360/BCM4352 Wi-Fi works
- webui: a box short of memory no longer drops off the network
- memory: a box that runs out of it recovers instead of freezing
- image: /var and /home are really filled from the image at first boot
- sources: network-share logins are sealed at rest, never in the clear
- website: take the site as it stands on main
- website: the support band moves up under the hero
- website: an email to support opens a ticket, not a GitHub issue
- website: lead with help in the band after Install
- website: a support chat in place of the review form
- vu store: the Titanium meter, redrawn, and a needle that reaches both ends
- kiosk: a remote can reach a text field, and the keyboard is always there
- add-ons: installing one must not take the screen away
- remote controls: one remote is one entry, however many devices it is
- setup wizard: after pairing, wait for the remote to actually turn up
- setup wizard: a refusal is not an answer about someone's hardware
- setup wizard: setup ends at "Complete setup", not three steps earlier
- bluetooth remotes: "not known yet" was being reported as "no bluetooth"
- setup wizard: the remote step needed buttons, not a list to read
- setup wizard: the remote control step, in the wizard people actually walk
- web admin: the remote control pages could not reach the device
- remote control: six fake remotes to test against, and a card to send
- remote control: the row says what the code actually does
- remote control: leave alone the remotes that already work
- bluetooth remotes: the bridge waits on BlueZ in a thread of its own
- bluetooth remotes: do not stand in for a kernel that manages by itself
- web admin: the remote control, and a last step in the setup
- kiosk: the VU meters get their own icon, and a key that reaches them
- factory reset: an if-then where shellcheck wants one
- kiosk: a remote control drives the whole interface
- bluetooth: pair a remote control, and keep the radio up for it
- kiosk: the Cover Flow covers follow the search filter
- backup: the album and artist information travels with it
- album and artist information: keeping it is not a switch
- album and artist information: it stays, and you choose where
- web admin: one CSRF token per page, not one per request
- vu store: Titanium turns on its coil, with a needle long enough to reach (v3)
- vu store: Titanium turns on its coil, with a needle long enough to reach (v3)
- vu store: the coil turns with the needle on Glossy and Titanium (v2)
- vu store: the coil turns with the needle on Glossy and Titanium (v2)
- vu store: two more meters, a glossy black one and a titanium one
- vu store: two more meters, a glossy black one and a titanium one
- sources: a network folder is writable unless it cannot be
- cassette: the label says the track playing, not the album
- bluetooth: the pairing agent lets go of a shutdown, and the plate follows any player
- kiosk: everything you can touch answers to the touch
- cd player (top loader): a slower disc, so the art can still be seen
- kiosk: network icon in the top bar, wifi settings that report and remember
- webui: the Ko-fi badge speaks in the first person
- webui: the support link is a Ko-fi badge in the top bar
- site: the support link, counted on its way to Ko-fi
- webui: one quiet support line under every admin page
- site: the support link, counted on its way to Ko-fi
- kiosk: cover flow, now playing choosers, guided tour, cd keys, cassette door
- bluetooth: speakers the appliance plays TO, one Lyrion player each
- boot: the image stops waiting for what nobody on screen waits for
- cd player (top loader): no black flash on a track change
- cd player (top loader): a slower, real spin-up
- cd player (top loader): the disc turns at a real CD's speed
- now playing: a settings gear; cd player: the drawer at a real one's pace
- cd player: the drawer comes out in perspective, joined to the player
- cd player: the inside of the player shows behind the open drawer
- cd player: a drawer with depth, no level knob, no badge
- cd player: the drawer comes out with the whole disc, the case fills the scene
- cd player: a late-80s front loader with a fluorescent display
- animations: an internet radio shows its station and the song playing
- ota: read the bundle size from Content-Range when HEAD has none
- webui: the animation pick shows a still of each scene, like the VU skins
- cassette: no tape or felt pad showing through the shell
- cassette: every track goes from one full reel to the other
- screensaver: the clock shows OSMIUM SOUND, not HIFI PLAYER
- cassette: the tape on the reels is as long as the track
- cassette: each key carries its name, in metallic ink at the top
- ci: run the prune-ota-r2 unit test with the other update tests
- ota: every channel downloads from file.osmiumsound.it, only the newest stays
- ota: download the image bundle to /data, then install it
- animations: one look per scene, the same in the panel and at full screen
- cassette: a volume fader instead of the knobs on the Now Playing deck too
- animations: a store for more Now Playing animations, and hifi-pack-install
- kiosk: network check, full-screen VU meters and 90s decks, screens of any shape
- one salt, and it lasts a week
- the week's salt dies when the week does
- site: drop the live count, keep the weekly one
- site: a live count of how many appliances are on
- site: count how many appliances ask for an update, with a week-long salt
- site: the download button points at Osmium Flasher 1.0.1
- flasher: 1.0.1
- docs: Secure Boot does not have to be turned off any more
- beta notice: say that the collection ended, instead of promising it will
- site: say where the data goes, as Art. 13(1)(f) asks
- site: the download server stops keeping addresses too, and the notice says so
- site: keep a day's sketch already merged, so reading a year is affordable
- site: tell a download click apart from the file going out
- site: count visitors and downloads without keeping anything about them
- library editor: fix the tags in the files and the online credits from the web admin
- kiosk: the long-press menu works inside apps, radio and favourites too
- site: the privacy page's own address is /privacy
- site: the privacy page says the server log keeps IP addresses
- site: privacy policy page at /privacy.html
- fix(companion): release build is obfuscated again — 1.0.12
- kiosk: album and artist pages with credits, band members and biographies
- metadata: album and artist information from MusicBrainz and Wikipedia; CD rips tagged with MusicBrainz ids
- vu-store: Aluminium v2 (new needles) and Copper v2 (new outer frame)
- vu-store: Aluminium v2 (new needles) and Copper v2 (new outer frame)
- kiosk: Now Playing animations — a CD, a vinyl record or a cassette in place of the VU meters
- vu-store: Copper, Golden and Aluminium, the first skins in the store
- vu-store: Copper, Golden and Aluminium, the first skins in the store
- vu-store: Copper, Golden and Aluminium, the first skins in the store
- kiosk: drop the presets, the favourites already cover that
- chore: version 2.5.25 — the next cycle after the stable 2.5.24
- kiosk: favourites, presets and playlist editing from the screen; library search, genres, years, composers, new music, refresh
- Update YouTube iframe source in index.html
- site: screen requirement lists the resolutions offered in Settings
- site: UEFI came before 2015, say which PCs have it
- site: no OTA channels badge in the hero
- site: hero without the power and memory figures
- site: screenshots of the Qt interface
- site: absolute og:image, social meta tags and more room for the demo video
- site: hardware requirements before the download
- site: fewer warnings before the download button
- site: hero leads with the mini PC you already own and the Qt footprint
- site: the features the README lists and the page left out
- site: AGPL license, Qt interface and the current specs
- docs: A/B image, add-ons, VU meter store and the recent UI changes
- docs: the on-screen interface is Qt now, not Electron
